title: Monument
description: A multi-stage monument or wonder. The building it names supplies the footprint, placement and unlock; this adds the stage bills and the effects that apply when the last stage completes. One file per monument in content/monuments/<id>.json.

building.description: The building (category monument or wonder) that is built.

stages.description: The bill for each stage, in build order. At least one stage, and every stage asks for something.

effects.description: Effects that start when the last stage completes. Unlock effects here count as unlock sources.
